notes.title: UI and Postprocessing Update
notes.notes: UI in the picture bool, store, and others have been updated to a better look. Bloom postprocessing has been added to some scenes for better looking game.

notes.title: Achievement Update
notes.notes: Achievements are finally here. Win the woman's affections and receive an achievement as a extra reward.

notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes:
I am excited to announce, after much anticipation the game is finally released. Issues with realism have been addressed. I will be adding Steam Achievements in the next update. Thank you to all who support my work. I hope you enjoy playing the game as much as I did making it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870306/3004f23bb7c6abbba9ad9a72d131e20269dad164.png

notes.title: Release update
notes.notes:
Unfortunately steam is delaying the release of this game due to a realism in the game. I have had to update the game to address this issue then re-submit. I apologize for any delays. The game should be ready soon.   

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870306/3004f23bb7c6abbba9ad9a72d131e20269dad164.png

notes.title: Release date
notes.notes: The release date is pending steam build testing. We hope to have the game released by the end of the month. Possibly sooner.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870306/960c8a67ef6221f183099809f7509f0c970e6ba9.png
